description: This Java source file defines the JpaAssetProfileDao class, which implements data access operations for AssetProfile entities in a SQL database within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for retrieving asset profile information, default profiles, profiles by name or tenant, and related data, utilizing Spring Data JPA repositories.

classes.name: JpaAssetProfileDao
classes.description: Data access object for AssetProfile entities, providing methods to query and manipulate asset profile data in a SQL database.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO, AssetProfileEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JPA repository for AssetProfileEntity.

methods.name: findAssetProfileInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves AssetProfileInfo by tenant ID and profile ID.

methods.name: findAssetProfiles
methods.description: Finds paginated list of AssetProfiles for a tenant based on PageLink.

methods.name: findAssetProfileInfos
methods.description: Finds paginated list of AssetProfileInfo for a tenant based on PageLink.

methods.name: findDefaultAssetProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the default AssetProfile for a tenant.

methods.name: findDefaultAssetProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the default AssetProfileInfo for a tenant.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds an AssetProfile by tenant ID and profile name.

methods.name: findAllWithImages
methods.description: Finds all AssetProfiles with non-null images, paginated.

methods.name: findTenantAssetProfileNames
methods.description: Lists asset profile names for a tenant, optionally only active ones.

methods.name: findAssetProfilesByTenantIdAndIds
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileInfo objects by tenant ID and list of profile IDs.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds an AssetProfile by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an AssetProfile by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds AssetProfiles for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for an internal AssetProfileId.

methods.name: findDefaultEntityByTenantId
methods.description: Finds the default AssetProfile for a tenant by UUID.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageLink
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileInfo objects by tenant ID and image link, limited by count.

methods.name: findByImageLink
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileInfo objects by image link, limited by count.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all AssetProfiles for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Finds the next batch of AssetProfileFields after a given ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is ASSET_PROFILE.
